moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: The Hundred's men's and women's cricket finals will take place at Lord's on Sunday, August 16, 2026, crowning the champions of the fast-paced 100-ball competition.

source.l: The Hundred Official Site / Cricket World

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Who's making it to Lord's? The Hundred Finals Day is just over a week away, promising non-stop action and drama. Who are you backing for glory?

angles.name: Finals Countdown
angles.copy: Cricket fans, mark your calendars! The Hundred Finals Day is set for August 16th. Expect fireworks as the best teams battle it out.

moments.title: The Hundred Live Matches
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket competition continues this weekend with MI London vs Trent Rockets and Southern Brave vs Manchester Super Giants today, August 8th, and Sunrisers Leeds vs Welsh Fire tomorrow, August 9th.

angles.name: Weekend Cricket
angles.copy: It's a huge weekend for The Hundred! Catch MI London vs Trent Rockets and Southern Brave vs Manchester Super Giants today, then Sunrisers Leeds take on Welsh Fire tomorrow. Who's got your support?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Action
angles.copy: Our very own Welsh Fire are in action tomorrow in The Hundred! Tune in to see them battle Sunrisers Leeds. Come on, Cymru!

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City, will be held at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, Wales, on Sunday, August 16, 2026.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Shield
angles.copy: Cardiff is hosting the FA Community Shield! Arsenal take on Manchester City at Principality Stadium on August 16th. A huge occasion for Welsh football fans!

angles.name: Premier League Curtain Raiser
angles.copy: The traditional curtain-raiser for the Premier League season is in Cardiff this year! Man City vs Arsenal for the Community Shield on August 16th. Who's taking home the first silverware?

moments.title: Edinburgh Festival Fringe Underway
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Festival Fringe, is in full swing, running from August 7th to August 31st, 2026, with thousands of shows across comedy, theatre, music, and more.

angles.name: Fringe Buzz
angles.copy: Edinburgh is alive with the Fringe! Comedy, drama, music, and spectacle – it's all happening right now. What shows are on your must-see list?

angles.name: Scottish Culture
angles.copy: The Edinburgh Festival Fringe is absolutely buzzing! Three weeks of incredible talent and performances transforming our capital. Who's heading to the Fringe this year?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of August 6th - 12th, 2026.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is holding strong at the UK Singles Chart #1 this week. Are you still streaming it?

angles.name: Weekend Soundtrack
angles.copy: Your weekend soundtrack just got confirmed: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still number one! What else is on your playlist?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's 'Petal' new chart entry
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's new track 'Petal' has entered the Official UK Singles Chart at number 4 this week.

angles.name: New Ariana
angles.copy: She's back in the top 5! Ariana Grande's 'Petal' is a brand new entry at number 4 on the UK Singles Chart. Have you heard it yet?

angles.name: Chart Impact
angles.copy: Ariana Grande makes a huge splash with 'Petal' debuting at #4! Is this her next big hit?

moments.title: Ian Anderson of Jethro Tull turns 79
moments.blurb: Ian Anderson, the iconic frontman and flautist of Jethro Tull, celebrates his 79th birthday on Monday, August 10, 2026. He was born in Dunfermline, Scotland.

angles.name: Prog Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 79th birthday to Ian Anderson of Jethro Tull on Monday! A true progressive rock legend and one of music's most distinctive voices (and flutes!). What's your favourite Jethro Tull track?

angles.name: Flute Master
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to Ian Anderson on August 10th! The man who made the flute rock and led Jethro Tull through decades of incredible music. Any memories of seeing them live?

moments.title: Joe Jackson turns 72
moments.blurb: British musician, singer, and songwriter Joe Jackson, known for hits like 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?' and 'Steppin' Out', celebrates his 72nd birthday on Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

angles.name: New Wave Legend
angles.copy: Happy 72nd birthday to the brilliant Joe Jackson on August 11th! From new wave anthems to jazz-inflected pop, his career is truly unique. Which of his songs is your favourite?

angles.name: Steppin' Out
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy birthday to Joe Jackson this Tuesday! The man behind 'Steppin' Out' and so many other classics. What's his best moment for you?

moments.title: Mark Knopfler of Dire Straits turns 77
moments.blurb: Mark Knopfler, the legendary guitarist, singer, and songwriter of Dire Straits, celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the one and only Mark Knopfler on Wednesday! The distinctive sound of Dire Straits is all thanks to this guitar legend. What's your top Dire Straits track?

angles.name: Sultans of Swing
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic birthday to Mark Knopfler this August 12th! From 'Sultans of Swing' to incredible film scores, his talent is undeniable.

moments.title: Madonna turns 68
moments.blurb: The 'Queen of Pop', Madonna Louise Ciccone, celebrates her 68th birthday on Sunday, August 16, 2026.

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: Long live the Queen! Madonna turns 68 on Sunday, August 16th. A true icon who has constantly reinvented pop music and culture. What's your favourite Madonna era?

angles.name: Material Girl
angles.copy: Get into the groove this Sunday for Madonna's 68th birthday! From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue', her impact is unmatched. Which of her hits do you love most?
